g.text: Agile method: a mix of Scrum and Kanban (Scrumban)
Initial architecture: a main class initialises the game,
starting on a TutorialScreen, then moving to a GameScreen
Timer for when events occur, plus modifying
Clarify whether pausing is for A1 or A2
Push any code to a branch
the charts he created and his draft doc
Effects of items, e.g. increasing player speed,
or an object for the goose to target instead of the player (bread)
Kamila: Method selection and planning writing
Everyone: Make sure writing is in the right format
Tom: Add writing to the website
Jake: Send Lulu architecture done so far and what is left
Manryan: Whole-shabang (player controller, map, geese spawning)
Tom: Counter (items used, events interacted with)
Kamila: Accessibility options (could be a text box)
Everyone: Finish code and put it on GitHub ASAP
Tom: Tile system for events (if it makes things easier)
Tom: Implement Boss goose with swarm event (timer triggered)
Lulu: Get libraries and assets writing from Aidan (q6b)
Aidan, Tom and Kamila: Review pull requests

Aidan: Docstrings for public and interface methods
Manryan: Evolution of project (get feedback from Lulu)
